description: This Java source file defines the CheckId class, which implements a method operation within the OFBiz MiniLang framework. It processes a <check-id> XML element, validating a field value against database ID rules and managing error messages. The class includes logic for handling different sub-elements like <fail-message> and <fail-property>, as well as validation and message expansion mechanisms.

classes.name: CheckId
classes.description: A class representing a <check-id> operation in MiniLang, responsible for validating a specified field value and recording errors if invalid.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the CheckId instance by parsing attributes and child elements from the XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the validation logic: checks if the field value is a valid database ID, and if not, adds an error message to the error list.
